# Synthetic Anna University R2023 end-semester paper, modelled on the real
# template and on the real coordinate geometry measured from
# OS-R2023-Supplementary-25.pdf. No corpus content is reproduced: the
# question wording is invented, the LAYOUT is what is being tested.
#
# Format: x | y | text          (see worker/src/testing/fixture-layout.ts)
#         "|h=7.7" sets a smaller glyph height.
#
# Deliberately reproduced from the real papers:
#   - the question number set in a smaller font on its own baseline, 4pt
#     below its question text (page 1, question 1);
#   - a question whose number glyph is MISSING entirely (question 9);
#   - Marks/CO/BL as right-hand cells, with the table in a DIFFERENT
#     horizontal position on page 2 than on page 1;
#   - a literal centred OR between 11(a) and 11(b);
#   - sub-parts splitting 13 into 5 + 8;
#   - a header whose year (2025) contradicts the filename hint (2022).
